content: When the RAM check fails on wakeup the ECU Manager mod- ule shall invoke EcuM_ErrorHook with the parameter ECUM_E_RAM_CHECK_FAILED . It is left integrator's discretion to allow EcuM_ErrorHook to relay the error to the DEM when he judges that the DEM will not write damaged NVRAM blocks.
